notes: Card: broad; ' population' x4, ' come' x3, ' ray' x2, ' came' x2. Logit effect of the + pole suppresses ' explosive', ' burst', ' explosion', so the - pole reads toward them, which fits gamma ray bursts and population explosion but ' burst' itself does not fire. Probe: gamma ray 0.52-0.84, population growth 0.31-0.53; X ray 0.04, ray of light 0.10, gamma knife 0.20, population of each town 0.15, most of the population 0.03. But population densities only 0.14.
